'''Kurask minions''' are summoned by the [[kurask overlord]] when fighting him during the [[Desert Slayer Dungeon (miniquest)|Desert Slayer Dungeon miniquest]]. They can be dealt with in a similar way to the kurask overlord. They require 70 [[Slayer]] to kill.

Like all kurasks, kurask minions are immune to all attacks not dealt via a [[leaf-bladed spear]], a [[leaf-bladed sword]], [[broad arrows]], [[broad-tipped bolts]], or the [[Slayer Dart]] spell. Players fighting the kurask overlord often choose to ignore the minions, as they disappear when the boss has been defeated.
